def: to address by an additional name; hence, to eulogize

words.word: neither let me give flattering titles

occurrences.text: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man’s person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.
words: neither let me give flattering titles

occurrences.text: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.
One shall say, I am the Lord’s; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the Lord, and surname himself by the name of Israel.
For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.
